A1.justification: Both PDFs describe HiDe. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable, allowing reliable matching despite extensive reformatting and reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original HiDe benchmark results, controlled background-interference experiments, component ablations, efficiency measurements and appendix analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical results and adds model evaluations, benchmark results, localization measurements and robustness analyses.

M1.justification: The documented LPD procedure expands: v1 Algorithm 1 directly compacts supplied boxes, whereas v2 Figure 13 first applies overlap-count filtering, merges overlapping boxes and decomposes regions by transparency. The central TAD attention purification, grid compaction and original-plus-compact inference pipeline remain unchanged.

E1.justification: v2 Appendix D adds document question answering on DocVQA and camouflaged-object presence/absence questions constructed from COD10K. These substantially broaden task coverage beyond the retained V*, HRBench, POPE and MME-RealWorld evaluations.

E2.justification: DeepEyes joins the efficiency comparison in Table 4, having previously appeared only in the accuracy comparison. Table 1 also adds unaugmented Qwen2.5-VL 3B and Qwen3-VL 8B comparators and ViCrop results with the 32B backbone. ViCrop-o becoming ViCrop* is a rename.

E3.justification: v2 adds evaluation configurations using Qwen2.5-VL 3B/32B and Qwen3-VL 8B, ground-truth-box IoU/precision/recall evaluation, layer-selection sample budgets, a restricted-resolution input cap and compact-only input controls. These are new protocols; the original experiments' core hardware, decoding and hyperparameter settings are retained.

E4.justification: New analyses quantify localization accuracy (Table 5), test sensitivity to layer choice and selection-sample count (Tables 9–10), examine restricted-resolution robustness (Table 11), and remove the original image to test global-context dependence (Table 12). The earlier component and hyperparameter ablations remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or significance tests. Temperature-zero decoding and Figure 4's averaging over ten intervention steps are retained. The new layer-selection sample counts describe evaluation design, not repeated-run statistical estimation.

E6.justification: v2 adds substantial model, task and diagnostic results, including 89.5% V* accuracy for HiDe with Qwen3-VL 8B and 81.8%/92.1% on DocVQA/COD10K with Qwen2.5-VL 7B. Original headline accuracies of 92.1% and 91.6% remain unchanged. Table 4 revises HiDe runtime from approximately 20 to 14 minutes without explaining the revision.

T1.justification: The attention definitions, smoothing, normalization, thresholding and coordinate transformation are mathematically equivalent. v2 abbreviates normalization using N and moves some expressions inline; it adds no substantive derivation, formal assumption, theorem or proof.

C1.justification: Both versions attribute high-resolution difficulties primarily to background interference, propose training-free TAD plus LPD, and claim strong benchmark performance and approximately 75% lower memory usage. The rewritten abstract and expanded conclusion retain these central contributions.

C2.justification: v2 newly interprets compact-only results as evidence that global context remains useful, discusses robustness to layer and hyperparameter choices, and extends applicability arguments to lower-resolution and general multimodal tasks. The core background-interference explanation and illustrated localization failure remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 documents COD10K question construction, DocVQA evaluation-file provenance, Qwen3 settings and additional LPD preprocessing. It clarifies that V*-selected configurations are reused across datasets. Existing hardware/settings move into Section 5.1, while the abstract replaces the repository link with a project-page release promise. The new overlap threshold n remains unspecified.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for Qwen3-VL, DocVQA, COD10K and two Feng et al. cross-modal studies. Its positioning relative to training-based and training-free approaches remains largely unchanged; several other reference changes merely update publication metadata.

P1.justification: The abstract, related work, method explanations, efficiency discussion and conclusion undergo extensive rewriting. Experimental settings move into the main text, appendices are reordered and expanded, and the standalone reproducibility and LLM-use statements disappear. These changes substantially alter document organization and exposition.

P2.justification: v2 adopts a two-column main-text layout, redesigns and relocates the opening analysis diagram, redraws Figure 3, and removes the original-image row from Figure 7. It expands benchmark tables, adds diagnostic tables and replaces Algorithm 1 with Figure 13's Python-style pseudocode. Most appendix visualizations are retained.

improvement.justification: The added localization measurements and layer, resolution and global-context tests provide useful validation beyond v1's existing component ablations. Broader model/task evaluations also clarify applicability, including very small gains on DocVQA and COD10K. The net improvement is limited by reporting gaps: the runtime revision is unexplained, and the expanded LPD procedure leaves its overlap threshold unspecified.
